descriptionFull: The willow ptarmigan (/ˈtɑːrmɪɡən/) ( Lagopus lagopus ) is a bird in the grouse subfamily Tetraoninae of the pheasant family Phasianidae. It is also known as the willow grouse and in Ireland and Britain, where it was previously believed to be a separate species, as the red grouse .
